datasets.name: stanfordvl/behavior-1k

upstream.licence: MIT (code and BDDL); BEHAVIOR Data Bundle under its own non-commercial licence (not redistributed)

run.label: Robo Use checkout + GPU worker
run.note: The BEHAVIOR simulator (OmniGibson 3.9.3 on Isaac Sim 5.1) needs an NVIDIA RTX GPU with RT cores and host driver 580 (Isaac Sim 5.1 crashed at start-up on driver 595). Start one simulator worker per activity on the GPU machine, write their endpoints to runs/_behavior/remote.json in a Robo Use checkout (branch behavior-expand), and run from that checkout; the setup is in docs/suites/behavior.md. Every task in this dataset was checked this way with the reference solutions and a no-op control.
run.bench_note: Not checked on this dataset: bench has no GPU sandbox. The packages expect the worker endpoints file in $ROBOUSE_BEHAVIOR_REMOTE on the host.

run.label: Robo Use checkout + GPU worker
run.note: RoboDojo runs on NVIDIA Isaac Sim 5.1, which needs an RTX GPU with RT cores and a driver from the 580 branch (it crashed at start-up on driver 595). Start one worker per task on the GPU machine (robodojo_worker.py in a RoboDojo checkout with its Hugging Face assets), write their endpoints to runs/_robodojo/remote.json in a Robo Use checkout (branch robodojo) and run from that checkout; the setup is in docs/suites/robodojo.md. Every task in this dataset was checked this way with the reference solutions and a no-op control.
